message.Title: Public Preview: Content Understanding chunking and image verbalization in Azure AI Search

Body.Content:
Azure AI Search now supports Content Understanding chunking and image verbalization in public preview, expanding the built-in skill that parses rich documents during indexing. Indexers can split documents into semantically meaningful chunks and generate text descriptions of embedded images, charts, and diagrams in the same pass. Retrieval-augmented generation apps benefit because each chunk carries the visual context that used to be lost when images were stripped out. Customers indexing slide decks, technical manuals, and scanned forms get higher answer quality without running a separate vision pipeline. The skill plugs into existing integrated vectorization workflows, so teams can add it to current skillsets without rebuilding indexes from scratch. This release ships under the same Azure AI Search billing and data residency commitments customers already use today. 

Learn more.

message.Title: Generally Available: Semantic chunking and AI-generated image descriptions with Azure Content Understanding in Azure AI Search

Body.Content:
The Azure Content Understanding skill in Azure AI Search is generally available for semantic chunking and AI-generated image descriptions, for use with Foundry IQ and Azure AI Search. The skill produces semantically coherent chunks with structured Markdown, location metadata, and searchable image descriptions in an Azure AI Search enrichment pipeline. 

Learn more.

message.Title: Generally Available: Semantic chunking and image descriptions with Azure Content Understanding in Foundry IQ

Body.Content:
Foundry IQ—formerly Azure AI Search—now offers generally available semantic chunking and optional AI-generated image descriptions through the Azure Content Understanding skill.

The skill uses document structure to create chunks with Markdown and location metadata. Configure a supported chat-model deployment to generate descriptions of supported images, charts, and diagrams.

Learn more.
